runner-pairing.title: Pair a remote Runner
runner-pairing.invalid_read: The pairing response could not be verified. Read the original request again.
runner-pairing.locator_failed: The public pairing locator could not be saved. Keep this request and recover the original result first.
runner-pairing.invalid_locator: The local pairing locator could not be verified. Preserve the original data and check the current account, organization and project.
runner-pairing.view_required: Read and confirm the current account, organization and project before pairing.
runner-pairing.worker_not_current: This Worker has not been verified in the current project's node list. Read it again before continuing configuration.
runner-pairing.intro: Create a pairing request in the current project, then run the credential-free command on the target machine. Compare its self-reported details and full fingerprint before explicitly approving the original node identity.
runner-pairing.reason.awaiting_machine: Waiting for the target machine's identity proposal. Run the original command, then refresh this request.
runner-pairing.reason.approval_required: The machine submitted its self-reported identity. Compare its name, control URL and complete fingerprint with the target terminal before explicitly approving.
runner-pairing.reason.control_changed: The control URL changed. This request cannot be approved. Check the current service and explicitly create a new pairing request through the original entry.
runner-pairing.reason.identity_approved: The node identity was approved. Wait for the target terminal to confirm it was saved, then return to the original tool configuration. Approval does not establish online status, fresh inventory, enablement or task execution.
runner-pairing.reason.pairing_rejected: This pairing was rejected and cannot be approved. Explicitly create a new request if connection is still needed.
runner-pairing.reason.pairing_expired: This pairing expired and is not extended automatically. Any identity already issued still requires its own current eligibility check.
runner-pairing.state_hint.waiting: Run the command below, then refresh this original request to view the machine's proposal. Copying does not execute or approve it.
runner-pairing.state_hint.proposed: Compare the self-reported machine name, control URL and complete fingerprint with the target terminal before explicitly approving.
runner-pairing.state_hint.approved: The server approved the node identity. Wait for the target terminal to confirm that the identity was saved, then return to the original tool configuration. Approval does not establish online status, fresh inventory, enablement or task execution.
runner-pairing.state_hint.rejected: This pairing was rejected and cannot be approved. Explicitly create a new request if connection is still needed.
runner-pairing.state_hint.expired: This pairing expired and is not extended automatically. Any identity already issued still requires its own current eligibility check.
runner-pairing.stale: The current pairing has not been confirmed again. Refresh before approving or continuing.
runner-pairing.pending: The original operation is unconfirmed. Recover that same receipt before creating or approving another request.
runner-pairing.fingerprint_help: Only the digest is shown. Compare all 64 characters with the target terminal, rather than checking only the prefix.
runner-pairing.identity_help: Leave blank for the target system's user configuration directory. Otherwise enter an absolute path on the target machine. The file holds only public identity data; the system credential store protects the secret. Keep the same path for retries.
runner-pairing.rerun_command: Need to rerun the original command on the target machine?
runner-pairing.command_incomplete: Choose the target shell and provide a valid absolute identity path if needed to copy the command.
runner-pairing.confirm: I compared the self-reported name and complete SHA-256 fingerprint with the target terminal and explicitly approve this original version of the node identity.
runner-pairing.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the command text and copy it manually.
